securityCorrection: Inherits v1.1 explicit signed actor binding; v1.1 action signatures are intentionally incompatible.
extension: Adds read-only EVM transaction context opcodes for router, authorized executor and recipient binding.

compatibility.signedActions: incompatible with v1.1 because the EIP-712 domain version changes
compatibility.bytecode: v1 bytecode remains valid unless it relied on 0xba, 0xbb or 0xbc being invalid

changePolicy: Any byte-level change to the v1.2 specification or ISA requires recalculating this manifest before tooling generation.
